findings.description: Scope/media growth is now declared in the signed authority and pinned by code, so it cannot exceed the two paths and frame.png; residual is that literals live in transport, and no test covers a lookMedia mismatch.

releasePolicySnapshot guards only keys matching /release|publish|demo/i (subtrees captured whole, added keys detected, runtime ceiling allowed); a release-gating field named otherwise in story-authority.json remains writable. Comparison is order-sensitive, so key reordering fails closed.
Walk now breaks before a nonpositive hold, but the break exits at the deadline without passing the in-loop timeout throw; correctness depends on the post-loop arrival assertion. No ceiling expansion.
Carried: probe self-produces the frame that satisfies the new look-media obligation; existence is not visual acceptance.
